output: Overlay checks passed: native terminal, workspace selection, MCP config preservation, trust, paths, provider routing, SDK syntax.
Native tools passed: actual SDK in-process registration, shared bundle, 20 handlers, real reference call and domain rejection; zero daemon commands.

Lazy KiCad tools passed: read-only tools without prompts, two stable discovery tools, selected schema and direct execution, message intent, stored-session evidence, the packaged CLI tool lists and a same-session relaunch that keeps history.
Prompt optimizer checks passed: selected model, text-only isolation, cancel, timeout, errors, empty output, tool rejection.
Composer backend checks passed: model isolation, bounded prediction, in-process catalog with schemas/access and cancellation; zero catalog subprocesses.
SDK probe lifecycle passed: success/timeout abort, bounded lifetime and no late orphan spawn.
Provider routing passed: endpoint precedence, validation, cross-provider and DeepSeek model changes, resume identity, modes and busy guard.
Membership passed: Codex provider routing, membership-only auth, plan tool denial, sandbox, completion and cross-provider historical context.
Config discovery passed: lightweight probes only, optional timeout preserves models and initialization, no chat or MCP startup/shutdown race.
Slash menu passed: provider-independent local entries, bounded metadata-only discovery, disabled skills, cleanup, secret-free MCP view and no model/tool/MCP execution.
Permissions passed: SDK capability and selected modes, pending Bash/MCP approval, explicit questions retained, no persistent rules, failed switch rollback.
Delegation enforcement passed: 8 queries, 11 turns; unauthorized child queries = 0.
Composer keyboard passed: Tab is reserved with/without predictions and open completion menus, IME protected, Shift+Tab mode shortcut retained.

Reasoning passed: provider capabilities, invalid effort rejection, same session and permissions, busy guard, no optimistic state on failure.
Model changes passed: failure retains old selection, unsupported effort resets, remembered per-model choice restores.

Dashboard event checks passed: SDK task/tool correlation, nested agents, cumulative usage, background results, terminal status, history and disconnect.
KiCad tools on demand: ordinary messages keep the process, KiCad requests keep the same process and discover only selected tools.
Model performance checks passed: zero process launches on selection, one restart on manual send, session/permissions retained, cancellation prevents enqueue.

Execution presentation passed: per-request grouping, final text, visible important issues and questions, tool failures, nested agents, result-only output, stop/disconnect, full record retention and ordinary chat.
Editor images passed: native image editor, exact/relative/Unicode paths, supported formats, missing files, text selections and directories.
Tool content passed: production open_content handler, named full snapshots, deduplication, cleanup, retry and no file writes or command execution.

Pause/resend lifecycle passed: fresh channel with original session/options, immediate resend, stale result/finally isolation, duplicate send prevention, startup cancellation, locked request controls and stale permission cleanup.
Model selection passed: delayed init, persisted explicit selection, new conversation, resume, explicit Default, failure rollback, busy guard, cancellation during init; no automatic sends.

Message editing passed: original slot replacement, repeated edits, preceding history, same session/model/permissions/effort, attachments, UUID echo dedup, persisted reopen, normal identical messages, failure preservation, pause/resend, stale reference, atomic concurrent storage.
Continuity passed: hooks record events and give advice without denying tools; malformed checkpoints do not crash; history/todos/pending state survive compaction.
Tool output passed: passive terminal, explicit reveal only, retained failures, redaction, no shell input, exact host command.
